description:
A Nikke from the Electric Shock squad.
She's the pioneer of the electrical engineering field.
Due to her lack of social skills, it's difficult for her to communicate with other Nikkes.

levels.name: T.Rony Bomber
levels.description:
■ Activates when landing a Full Charge attack while there are no enemies in the T.Rony Bomber state. Affects the enemy nearest to the crosshair.
<color=#00AEFF>Activates <word_group=10049>Cumulative Damage Skill</word_group> for 5 sec.
Function: Accumulates a portion of the skill user's inflicted damage. Once the maximum amount is accumulated, damage will be dealt to enemies and the effect will be removed.
Effect 1: Sets the max amount of accumulated damage to 907.63% of the skill user's <word_group=10025>final</word_group> ATK.
Effect 2: Accumulates 50% of the skill user's attack damage.
Effect 3: Deals <word_group=10019>distributed damage</word_group> to <word_group=10020>enemies within the attack range</word_group> when <word_group=10049>Cumulative Damage Skill</word_group> explodes.</color>

lines.text: It's lovely weather outside today. Perfect day to stay inside and play some games.

If there is any electronic equipment you need, I could try making it for you.
I... I'm actually quite confident with this sort of thing!

Umm... Commander... Er, forget it, it's nothing...
I'll tell you later. Maybe next week? No, maybe next month...

Elegg is so very, er...
Very... BOOM.

Personally, I think the best game ever made is Combat Ace...
But don't tell Elegg that.

Electricity is made by boiling water and spinning a turbine...
Oh, I guess I'm boring you. Sorry... I'll go in the corner and stay quiet.

Commander...? Are you outside?
Phew, finally I'm alone. Hehe, this is nice.

Is there anyone here? Hmm... I'm Trony, and I'm here to uphold justice! 
Prepare yourself, villain! Hehe, just like the way Ark Ranger Black would say it.

The Ark Rangers movie just got released in theaters. If-if you happen to have time, would you... 
No, there's no way you would want to come with me... I'll just go and watch it by myself...

Have you seen Elegg?
We were together just a moment ago, but I think she might have left...

You said that the elevator breaks down a lot, right?
Um... I think I'll just wait inside for a bit. I prefer being alone.
I-I'm Trony. Glad to be part of the team.
Note to self: Circuit calibration should be reinforced this way.
Wow, this feeling reminds me of BOOM.
I definitely feel stronger, even if you can't really tell...

Um, just a moment. Let me jot down a note on the computer.
I got a gift from Commander today, hehe...

Um... D-don't look at me like that.
Am I making a strange face right now?

It's just a tiny gift, so l-I should probably calm down...
Hehe... hehehe.

Th-thank you for always being nice to...
Uhh, it feels like my heart is about to explode.

If there's any Ark Rangers merchandise that you want, I could maybe get you one... or two.
You know... as a token of my appreciation.

Being with you makes me feel so comfortable...
I'm looking forward to doing it more.
M-me? Wouldn't it be better to send another Nikke instead of me?
Oh, um... You called?
I'll be right there.
I've got your back.
Be careful not to run out of battery.
I-I'm glad to be in this foxhole with you all.
I guess I should do what needs to be done...
Huh? The battery is dead.
Repair complete.
Just need to do some fixing... Don't leave me behind.
Preparation complete.
Work complete. I did it! Hehe.
Give them an electrifying blow!
Neutralized.
Let's wrap this up and go home...
D-did you see that? I defeated it.
Eek!
Ugh...
Ah...

I guess this is where I fall.
It's been an honor to be fighting alongside you all...
I... I feel kinda cool, hehe.
